overview: Example Township is a general-purpose municipality that delivers local services.
responsibilities: Maintains streets, parks, and zoning within township limits.
decision_makers: A five-member board of trustees sets policy; a manager runs day-to-day operations.
resident_participation: Residents may comment at monthly board meetings and petition for ballot measures.

get_involved.title: Attend a board meeting
get_involved.description: Sign up for the public comment list before the meeting.
